Name: Sakura Interface Redux
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
So I really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11266]Sakura Interface[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/82417688]eyeyumi[/url] but the mod was not updated and some part of the UI were no recolored. I reached out to them, and they kindly allowed me to pick up the project, and I am proud to present [b]Sakura Interface Redux[/b]!

At the moment, this interface is fully available in English. The title menu is English only (will update soon), but the rest of the game is available in German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese Japanese, Chinese & Korean.

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b]Config options:[/b]
You can edit the config in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.

[b]There are three options:[/b]
Billboard type: Clean or stickers. (see mod images for details)
ConcernedApe Logo: Vanilla (uses the vanilla logo) or Flowers (uses eyeyumi's gorgeous blooming flower).
Cursors: full version (Sakura), slightly edited cursors that matches the recolor (Vanilla style) or off (Off).

[b]Add-ons:[/b]
In the optional files of the Files tab, you'll see an add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
There is also an optional download for a custom background for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398?tab=description]Farmer Portraits[/url].


[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/X7q4vPs1/About.png[/img][/center]
If you want to talk about mod making, anything Stardew-related or just chat, feel free to message me on Nexus, ping me in the Stardew Valley Discord [i]TheFrenchDodo#7155[/i] or join the [url=https://discord.gg/sdveastscarp]East Scarp Discord server[/url]!

If you enjoy my mods, feel free to buy me a coffee on[url=https://ko-fi.com/thefrenchdodo] Ko-fi[/url]!

Check out my other mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creative Differences - Rodney a new NPC for East Scarp[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13909]Townsfolk posters[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13756]Horse to Ostrich[/url]

[b]Planned updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Title menu in other languages
[*]Compatibility for mods that add interface elements (Generic Mod Config Menu, Better Chests...). Feel free to suggest other mods.
[/list]
If you encounter an issue with the interface, feel free to let me know!
[b]

Downloads.Description:
Replaces the buttons for Generic Mod Config Menu to match Sakura Interface Redux.
Installation:
Copy and paste the 2 files into Mods/GenericModConfigMenu/Assets. Overwrite the files.

Downloads.Description:
Portrait background for Farmer Portraits.
Installation:
Copy and paste the file into Mods/[CP] Farmer Portrait/assets. Overwrite the file. In the config.json file for Farmer Portraits, set "UseCustomPortrait" to true.

Updated for the assets added by SDV 1.6.

New assets were recoloured by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/basemwnt]basemwnt[/url], thank you very much for your help!
